description:
Test bed for the duke-agent CLI. E-commerce SaaS schema with 51 SQLite tables,
~30 ETL scripts, and a mix of tokenisation modes per duke_agent_cli.md §12.x.

Tokenisation-mode mix:
  - FULLY VERIFIED (mode B precise) — every column has verify=true; only true
    PII columns also have to_tokenize=true:
      raw_customers, raw_orders, raw_order_items, raw_products, raw_refunds,
      raw_payments, raw_addresses, raw_shipments, raw_marketing_campaigns,
      raw_marketing_attribution, raw_support_tickets,
      staging_customers, staging_orders, staging_order_items,
      staging_refunds_with_flags, staging_marketing_attribution,
      staging_payments, staging_shipments, staging_support_tickets,
      dim_customer, dim_product, dim_date, dim_campaign, dim_supplier, dim_geo,
      fact_orders, fact_revenue, fact_refunds, fact_marketing_spend,
      fact_inventory, fact_payments, fact_shipments, fact_support_tickets,
      mart_customer_lifetime_value, mart_cohort_retention, mart_daily_revenue.

  - PARTIALLY VERIFIED (mode B because at least one column is verified, but
    most columns are unflagged — the table is "escalated" so the text-type
    fallback is dropped):
      raw_product_variants, raw_sessions, raw_page_views, raw_reviews,
      raw_suppliers, staging_sessions, dim_warehouse, dim_currency,
      fact_sessions.

  - UNVERIFIED (mode A — defensive tokenize-all-VARCHARs):
      staging_product_inventory, dim_payment_method, dim_channel, fact_reviews,
      mart_funnel_conversion, mart_top_products.

scripts.description: Lowercase email, concat full name, derive is_active.
Convert order totals to USD via dim_currency.
Tag refunds where amount > $500 AND reason in (chargeback, dispute_won).
Denormalise products with supplier and variant info.
Build the campaign dimension with is_active derived.
Materialise fact_refunds. MUST filter raw_refunds.deleted_at IS NULL.
Allocate campaign budget across each active day.
Visit → product_view → add_to_cart → checkout → purchase funnel.
Top-N products per calendar month, ranked by gross USD revenue.
Data-quality check: refunds referencing non-existent orders.
Alert if a column's NULL rate jumps > 5pp week-over-week.
Pull marketing attribution from the ad-server export.
DESTRUCTIVE: scrub PII columns for customers > 7 years inactive.
